casino.label: Crypto casino
casino.data_route: insight_sql.py --sector casino (labelled deposit addresses). Deeper: hidden-vip-packs (casino vertical), onchain-entity-prospect-reports for a wallet list or omnibus.
hero_ideas: hidden VIPs: small deposits here, large at other casinos
share of players who fund two or more casinos
for every $1 deposited here, how much the same players deposit elsewhere (the top-1% share is visible in their own back office: use it only as support)
urgency_hooks: a rival's outage, paused withdrawals or licence loss
a rival's bonus or rakeback change

avoid.spend: the data is deposits: say deposits, not spend or wagering

sample.title: Your next VIPs already play *somewhere else*
sample.subtitle: What on-chain data shows about casino players like yours.
sample.line: players deposit under $500 at one casino and *over $5,000 at others*.

sportsbook.label: Sportsbook
sportsbook.data_route: insight_sql.py --sector sportsbook (same deposit labels as casinos: choose sports-led brands as the set). Sports trading on prediction markets comes from event_horizon.user_profiles (sports_bets) through sales-reports for a client, or hidden-vip-packs for a batch.
hero_ideas: bettors who also trade sports on prediction markets
bettors funding two or more books before a big fixture
hidden VIPs: small stakes here, large elsewhere
urgency_hooks: the fixture calendar: a tournament, a season start, a final (date it)
a rival's market exit or licence change

avoid.spend: the data is deposits: say deposits, not spend or wagering

sample.title: Your sharpest bettors also bet *somewhere else*
sample.subtitle: What on-chain data shows about sports bettors like yours.
sample.line: of bettors fund *two or more books* in the same month.

prediction.label: Prediction market
prediction.data_route: No cheap query here: prediction markets are contracts, not deposit addresses. Use hidden-vip-packs (prediction vertical: contract seeds, peer_sql) or, for a client, sales-reports (predictionmarkets_* and sports_bets columns). Proxy sets are other prediction markets.
hero_ideas: traders who are small here and large on exchanges or perps
share of volume from the top 1% of traders
traders active on two or more markets
urgency_hooks: an election, a final or a macro print with a date
a regulator's ruling on event contracts
a rival's listing, fee or incentive change

avoid.gambl: prediction markets position as trading, not gambling

sample.title: Your smallest traders may be your *biggest*
sample.subtitle: What on-chain data shows about prediction-market traders like yours.
sample.line: traders put under $500 here and *over $5,000 on exchanges and perps*.

exchange.label: Trading platform
exchange.data_route: insight_sql.py --sector exchange (global and regional exchange deposit labels). Deeper: hidden-vip-packs (exchange-major, exchange-local), whynow_sql.py from prospect-deck-check for flows and switchers after an event.
hero_ideas: traders with a small first deposit here and six figures on other exchanges
share of a rival's recent users who already know you (warm win-back)
share of deposits from the top 1%
urgency_hooks: a rival's hack, outage or frozen withdrawals
a licensing deadline or product ban in a market

avoid.whale: fine for crypto-native teams; say high-value trader for regulated ones

sample.title: A $50 deposit can hide a *six-figure trader*
sample.subtitle: What on-chain data shows about exchange users like yours.
sample.line: traders deposit under $500 here and *over $5,000 on other exchanges*.

perps.label: Perps and derivatives
perps.data_route: Perp DEXs are contracts: use hidden-vip-packs (perps vertical, contract seeds) or, for a client, sales-reports (perps_* columns). For a centralised derivatives venue, insight_sql.py --sector exchange.
hero_ideas: traders testing you with hundreds while running six figures on other venues
share of volume from the top 1%
traders whose volume is growing on a rival this month
urgency_hooks: a rival's points or incentive season ending (date it)
a rival's outage, exploit or liquidation event
a new listing or fee change

sample.title: They test you with hundreds and trade *six figures elsewhere*
sample.subtitle: What on-chain data shows about perp traders like yours.
sample.line: traders put under $500 here and *over $50,000 on other venues*.

fx.label: FX and CFD broker

labels.what_we_see: What clients like yours do in crypto

fx.data_route: Brokers rarely have an on-chain trail, so this is almost always proxy mode. insight_sql.py --sector brokerage reads retail brokerages and exchanges together: the set is the labelled brokerages or exchanges closest to the prospect's client base. State plainly that the numbers describe crypto-funding traders, not the broker's own book.
hero_ideas: active crypto traders in the broker's markets who fund several venues
how concentrated funding is in the top 1% of traders
traders who fund a brokerage and an exchange in the same month
urgency_hooks: a regulator's leverage, marketing or licensing change (cite the regulator)
a volatility event or central-bank date
a rival broker adding crypto funding or crypto CFDs

sample.title: Your next high-value clients already *trade crypto*
sample.subtitle: What on-chain data shows about active traders in your markets.
sample.line: of active crypto traders fund *two or more venues* in a quarter.

default.label: Web3 company
default.data_route: Pick the closest vertical above, or use hidden-vip-packs seed modes (contract, holders, pixel, provider) for protocols, tokens and wallets.
hero_ideas: users who are small here and large elsewhere
urgency_hooks: a dated event near the prospect

sample.title: Your best users are bigger *somewhere else*
sample.subtitle: What on-chain data shows about users like yours.
sample.line: users are small here and *large elsewhere*.
